subject: math
topicName: Statistics - Lesson 10: Conclusions from Position Measures
description: Use quartiles, percentile rank, IQR, and displays to draw evidence-based conclusions from statistical data.
learningObjectives: Find and interpret quartiles, median, and interquartile range from ordered data.
Estimate percentile rank and explain relative standing in context.
Compare data sets using box plots, median, and IQR.
Write evidence-based conclusions that cite a statistic and explain its meaning.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Find the median of a data set
Read scales on simple statistical displays
Write a short explanation using evidence
